name: THE VALLEY OF ASHES
blurb: The road from New York runs black through the Valley. Steer Gatsby's yellow car through the crossing.
command: KEEP YOUR EYES ON THE ROAD
how: W / ↑ accelerate · S / ↓ brake · A / ← steer left · D / → steer right · SPACE skid

win.kicker: CHAPTER VII · THE VALLEY OF ASHES
win.title: THE YELLOW CAR
win.body: The yellow car hits Myrtle Wilson outside her husband's garage. The road falls silent; by morning the story will have a name, and Gatsby will let them say it was his. {speedLine}
win.quote: Her voice is full of money.
win.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby

lose.kicker: CHAPTER VII · THE VALLEY OF ASHES
lose.title: SHE STEPPED BACK
lose.body: Myrtle Wilson reaches the far side of the road. The yellow car rushes past; the moment is gone, and the road runs on toward East Egg. {speedLine}
lose.quote: There are only the pursued, the pursuing, the busy and the tired.
lose.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby
